# zuint

The goal of zuint is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of zuint from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zuint")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(zuint)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`zu_storage()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zu_storage.md)
  [`zu_from_storage()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zu_storage.md)
  : Raw storage of a zuint vector
- [`NA_int64_`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zuint-na.md)
  [`NA_uint64_`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zuint-na.md)
  [`NA_int128_`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zuint-na.md)
  [`NA_uint128_`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zuint-na.md)
  : Missing values of each type
- [`int64()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zuint-types.md)
  [`uint64()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zuint-types.md)
  [`int128()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zuint-types.md)
  [`uint128()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuint/reference/zuint-types.md)
  : Wide integer vectors
